title: Gallaudet co-writes the Bluegill Triple Prime report
place_text: Bluegill Triple Prime nuclear test site

tellings.quote: I helped Jeff Krookchank write the report on it.

plain: A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says he helped write a report on Bluegill Triple Prime, a US nuclear test of 1962. He tells Michels, 'I helped Jeff Cruickshank write the report on it,' naming Cruickshank as the main author. In Gallaudet's telling, it means he worked directly on the record of that test.
